cd /app && timeout 1200 python -c "
import mteb, warnings, logging
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore'); logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
b=mteb.get_benchmark('MTEB(Scandinavian, v1)')
tasknames=[t.metadata.name for t in b.tasks]
res=mteb.load_results(download_latest=False, tasks=b.tasks)
res=res.join_revisions()
rows=res.get_scores(format='wide')
import statistics
full=[]
for r in rows:
    scores={k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ('model','revision')}
    present=[t for t in tasknames if t in scores and scores[t] is not None]
    if len(present)==len(tasknames):
        m=statistics.mean(scores[t] for t in tasknames)
        full.append((m,r['model'],r['revision']))
full.sort(reverse=True)
print('models with all',len(tasknames),'tasks:',len(full))
for m,name,rev in full[:15]:
    print(round(m*100,2), name)
" 2>&1 | tail -20
